b.txt.content:
The ancient lighthouse stood on the black cliffs.
Its beam swept the dark water every night.
Keeper Marlow trimmed the lamp at dawn.
Fog rolled in from the north each spring.
Ships followed the steady glow to harbor.

The old lighthouse stood on the black cliffs.
